answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 20840 Country: India Title: is it sunnat or biddat to kiss hands and put them on eyes,when we listen to ADHAN ie..(ASH HADUANNA MUHAMMADAR RASOOLULLAH)? Question: AS SALAAMU ALAIKUM is it sunnat or biddat to kiss hands and put them on eyes,when we listen to ADHAN ie..(ASH HADUANNA MUHAMMADAR RASOOLULLAH)? Answer ID: 20840 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 516/439/B=1431) No, it is not sunnah. Such action is not narrated by the holy Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) from any Sahih hadith. Hafiz ibn Hajar Asqalani ( رحمة الله عليه ) the commentator of Bukhari, has termed it innovation. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
